title: Isolation and Culture of Pure Adult Mouse Microglia and Astrocytes
author: Milner, Lawrence, et al.

steps.title: Prepare reagents and equipment
steps.instruction: Obtain institutional permission, prepare Adult Glial Media (AGM) and MACS buffer as described in Materials, and pre‑cool the centrifuge to 4 °C.

steps.title: Sacrifice mouse and isolate brain
steps.instruction: Euthanize the adult (≥4 weeks) or aged mouse with CO₂, spray with ethanol, decapitate with sterile scissors, remove the skull, and work thereafter in a biosafety cabinet.

steps.title: Prepare enzyme mix and dissociate brain
steps.instruction: Place the brain in a 50 mL Falcon tube with 1 mL ice‑cold PBS‑g; prepare enzyme mix (50 µL Enzyme P, 1 900 µL Buffer Z, 20 µL Buffer Y, 10 µL Enzyme A) in a C‑tube, add the brain, roughly chop with a scalpel, run the gentleMACS OctoDissociator with heaters using program 37 °C_ABDK_01 (≈30 min).

steps.title: Collect, filter and centrifuge homogenate
steps.instruction: After dissociation, centrifuge the C‑tube at 500 × g for 5 s, resuspend the pellet, filter through a 70 µm cell strainer into a 50 mL Falcon tube, wash the C‑tube with 10 mL ice‑cold PBS‑g and pass through the strainer, centrifuge the filtrate at 300 × g for 10 min at 4 °C, remove supernatant, resuspend the pellet in 1 mL ice‑cold PBS‑g, transfer to a 15 mL Falcon tube and bring the volume to exactly 3 100 µL with PBS‑g.

steps.title: Debris removal and red‑blood‑cell lysis
steps.instruction: Add 900 µL Debris Removal Solution to the 3 100 µL suspension, gently overlay with 4 mL PBS‑g, centrifuge at 3 000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C with NO brake, discard the top two layers, fill the tube with PBS‑g and centrifuge at 1 000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C with brake, resuspend the pellet in 1 mL 1× Red Blood Cell Removal solution, incubate 10 min on ice (4 °C), add 10 mL PBS containing 1 % FCS to stop lysis, centrifuge at 300 × g for 10 min at 4 °C. The resulting pellet is the total single‑cell brain suspension.

steps.title: Choose isolation route
steps.instruction: Proceed with either Protocol I (magnetic CD11b⁺ microglia isolation) or Protocol II (mixed glial culture followed by mechanical and magnetic separation).

steps.title: Resuspend cells for magnetic sorting (Protocol I)
steps.instruction: Resuspend the bulk brain cell suspension in MACS buffer at 90 µL per 1 × 10⁷ cells (≈3 × 10⁶ cells typically obtained per adult brain).

steps.title: Add CD11b magnetic beads (Protocol I)
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL anti‑CD11b magnetic beads per 1 × 10⁷ cells (minimum 10 µL if cell number is lower) and incubate 15 min on ice at 4 °C.

steps.title: Wash labeled cells (Protocol I)
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL MACS buffer, centrifuge 300 × g for 10 min at 4 °C, and aspirate the supernatant.

steps.title: Prepare MS column (Protocol I)
steps.instruction: Place a MACS MS column onto an OctoMACS magnetic separator, add a 70 µm cell strainer on top, and apply 500 µL MACS buffer to equilibrate the column.

steps.title: Load and wash cells on column (Protocol I)
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 500 µL MACS buffer, apply to the MS column through the strainer, then wash the column three times with 500 µL MACS buffer each.

steps.title: Elute CD11b⁺ microglia (Protocol I)
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL MACS buffer to the column, remove the column from the magnetic separator, and expel the buffer with the supplied plunger into a fresh 15 mL Falcon tube (this is the CD11b⁺ fraction).

steps.title: Pellet and resuspend microglia (Protocol I)
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the CD11b⁺ fraction at 300 × g for 10 min at 4 °C, aspirate supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in 300 µL AGM.

steps.title: Count and seed microglia (Protocol I)
steps.instruction: Count live cells with a hemocytometer (Trypan Blue), seed at 3 × 10⁵ cells / cm² in AGM containing 50 ng/mL GM‑CSF and 100 ng/mL M‑CSF, incubate at 37 °C/5 % CO₂; change media the next day and every second day thereafter, and assay phenotypes on day 5.

steps.title: Plate mixed glial culture (Protocol II)
steps.instruction: Resuspend the bulk brain cell suspension in 7.5 mL AGM supplemented with 50 ng/mL GM‑CSF and 100 ng/mL M‑CSF, and add to a T25 culture‑grade flask (day 0).

steps.title: Culture mixed glia (Protocol II)
steps.instruction: Incubate at 37 °C/5 % CO₂ for 11–14 days. On day 5 replace half of the medium with fresh AGM (same cytokine concentrations). On day 10 discard all medium and add fresh AGM with the same cytokines.

steps.title: Shake to release microglia (Protocol II)
steps.instruction: On days 11–14, bring the flask volume to 10 mL, shake at 180 rpm at 37 °C without CO₂ for 2.5 h; collect the shaken media, wash the flask with 5 mL ice‑cold PBS, combine washes, centrifuge at 300 × g for 10 min at room temperature, aspirate supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in 300 µL AGM.

steps.title: Count and seed microglia (Protocol II)
steps.instruction: Count live cells (Trypan Blue), seed at 3 × 10⁵ cells / cm² in AGM with 50 ng/mL GM‑CSF and 100 ng/mL M‑CSF, culture 2 days at 37 °C/5 % CO₂, and assay phenotypes on day 2.

steps.title: Detach astrocytes from flask (Protocol II)
steps.instruction: Add 2.5 mL pre‑warmed 37 °C trypsin‑EDTA to the flask, incubate 5 min at 37 °C/5 % CO₂, tap the flask firmly, incubate another 5 min, tap again, add 5 mL AGM to inactivate trypsin, and scrape remaining adherent cells.

steps.title: Collect and filter astrocyte suspension (Protocol II)
steps.instruction: Transfer the cell suspension to a 50 mL Falcon tube, centrifuge 300 × g for 10 min at room temperature, aspirate supernatant, resuspend pellet in 2 mL PBS, pass through a 70 µm cell strainer, wash the strainer with 10 mL PBS, centrifuge the combined flow‑through at 300 × g for 10 min, aspirate, and resuspend the pellet in 90 µL MACS buffer per flask (≈1–2 × 10⁶ cells).

steps.title: Count astrocytes (Protocol II)
steps.instruction: Determine live cell number with a hemocytometer (Trypan Blue).

steps.title: Magnetic depletion of CD11b⁺ cells (Protocol II)
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL anti‑CD11b magnetic beads per 1 × 10⁷ cells (minimum 10 µL), incubate 15 min on ice at 4 °C, add 2 mL MACS buffer, centrifuge 300 × g for 10 min at 4 °C, aspirate supernatant, prepare a fresh MS column (place on OctoMACS separator, add 70 µm strainer, equilibrate with 1 mL MACS buffer, position a 15 mL Falcon tube underneath), resuspend the cell pellet in 500 µL MACS buffer, apply to the column, wash column three times with 500 µL MACS buffer, collect the flow‑through (purified astrocytes), pellet at 300 × g for 10 min at 4 °C, aspirate, and resuspend in 300 µL AGM.

steps.title: Count and seed astrocytes (Protocol II)
steps.instruction: Count live astrocytes, seed at 3 × 10⁵ cells / cm² in AGM, change medium every second day, and assay phenotypes on day 5.

steps.title: Surface marker staining for flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells in 50 µL PBS in a 96‑well round‑bottom plate, incubate 20 min on ice in the dark; prepare unstained, single‑stained, and FMO controls; wash with 150 µL PBS and centrifuge 600 × g for 5 min at room temperature, aspirate, and if only surface markers are needed, resuspend in 100 µL PBS and transfer to FACS tubes containing 150 µL PBS.

steps.title: Intracellular marker staining for flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells in 100 µL BD FixPerm solution, incubate 20 min at 4 °C in the dark; wash with 100 µL 1× BD FixPerm Wash buffer, centrifuge 600 × g for 5 min; stain in 50 µL FixPerm Wash buffer containing intracellular antibodies (e.g., CD68) for 15 min on ice in the dark; wash with 150 µL FixPerm Wash buffer, centrifuge 600 × g for 5 min, aspirate, resuspend in 100 µL PBS, and transfer to FACS tubes with 150 µL PBS.

steps.title: Acquire flow cytometry data
steps.instruction: Run samples on a flow cytometer (e.g., BD LSR Fortessa X‑20), set PMT voltages using unstained and single‑stained controls, acquire compensation using single‑stained samples.

steps.title: Analyze flow cytometry data
steps.instruction: Export FCS files, load into FlowJo, use FMO samples to define gates, export percentages, and plot data with GraphPad Prism for purity and phenotype comparisons.

steps.title: Coat coverslips for immunocytochemistry
steps.instruction: Place 12 mm 1.0′ coverslips in a 24‑well plate, add 500 µL Poly‑L‑lysine (1:10 dilution in water), incubate 1 h at room temperature, wash three times with sterile PBS, and let dry overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Plate cells on coverslips
steps.instruction: After shaking (step 20), plate adult microglia (100 000 cells in 500 µL) on coated coverslips and culture 2 days at 37 °C/5 % CO₂; plate astrocytes (50 000 cells in 500 µL) after CD11b depletion and culture 5 days under the same conditions.

steps.title: Fix and block cells
steps.instruction: Aspirate media, wash cells twice with PBS, fix with 4 % paraformaldehyde for 15 min at room temperature, wash three times with PBS, and block with 0.5 % BSA/PBS for 30 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Primary antibody staining
steps.instruction: Incubate cells 1 h at room temperature in 0.5 % BSA/PBS containing primary antibodies (e.g., anti‑Iba1 1:500, 1 µg/mL; anti‑GFAP 1:500, 1 µg/mL).

steps.title: Wash after primary staining
steps.instruction: Wash coverslips five times with PBS, 5 min each wash.

steps.title: Secondary and nuclear staining
steps.instruction: Incubate 1 h at room temperature in 0.5 % BSA/PBS containing DAPI (1:1 000, 20 ng/mL), phalloidin‑647 (1:40), Alexa Fluor 488 anti‑goat (1:500, 4 µg/mL), and Alexa Fluor 594 anti‑rabbit (1:500, 4 µg/mL).

steps.title: Wash after secondary staining
steps.instruction: Wash five times with PBS, 5 min each.

steps.title: Mount coverslips
steps.instruction: Mount coverslips on microscope slides with ProLong Gold antifade reagent, seal edges with clear nail polish, let dry 1 h at room temperature, and store at 4 °C for long‑term storage.
